common.notAffiliated: NTUST Notify is an independent student project and is not affiliated with National Taiwan University of Science and Technology.

login.title: Get into the course you need.
login.subtitle: Watch full courses and get an email or Discord alert the moment a seat opens — checked around the clock, even when your laptop is closed.
login.privacy: We only use your Google email to send you alerts. Delete your data any time.
login.step1Body: Search by course number, name, or teacher and see live seat counts.
login.step2Body: Add full courses to your watchlist. Alerts turn on automatically.
login.step3Body: We check NTUST 24/7 and email or ping you on Discord the moment someone drops.

search.title: Find a course
search.subtitle: Search the NTUST catalogue and watch any course to get alerted when a seat opens.
search.idleTitle: Search to see live seat counts
search.idleBody: Results show how many seats are left right now. Watch any course — full or not — and we'll alert you when a seat opens.
search.tip1: A partial course number like “CS30” lists every matching course.
search.tip2: Course names work in Chinese or English.
search.tip3: Your watchlist and alerts sync to every device you sign in on.

filterEmpty.open: None of these courses have open seats right now.
filterEmpty.full: None of these courses are full.

search.noResultsBody: Check the semester, or try a shorter course number or a different name.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.noChannelShort: Alerts can't reach you yet — turn on email or Discord.
watchlist.stale: Couldn't reach NTUST — showing the last known count.
watchlist.watchingHint: We'll alert you when a seat opens.
watchlist.emptyBody: Search for a course and tap Watch. We'll check it around the clock and alert you the moment a seat opens.

banner.noChannelTitle: Your alerts have nowhere to go
banner.noChannelBody: You're watching courses, but no alert channel is on — so you won't be notified when a seat opens.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle_one: Choose how to hear about open seats. Alerts are on for {{count}} course.
alerts.subtitle_other: Choose how to hear about open seats. Alerts are on for {{count}} courses.
alerts.emailUnavailable: Email alerts aren't available on this server right now.
alerts.discordBody: Post to a channel in your server through a webhook.
alerts.webhookHint: Keep this private — anyone with it can post to your channel.
alerts.userIdHint: In Discord: Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode, then right-click your name → Copy User ID.
alerts.helpSummary: How do I get a webhook URL?
alerts.help1: In Discord, open the server and channel you want alerts in.
alerts.noChannel: Turn on at least one channel, or you won't be notified.
alerts.frequencyBody: How often the server checks NTUST for open seats in your watched courses.
alerts.privileged: Your account can use the fastest interval.
alerts.testBody: Make sure alerts actually reach you before a seat opens.
alerts.testNoChannel: Turn on a channel and save to send a test.
alerts.testSaveFirst: Save your changes first, then send a test.
alerts.dangerBody: Permanently remove your watchlist, alert settings and sign-in. This can't be undone.
alerts.deleteBody: Your watchlist, alert settings and the sign-in for {{email}} will be permanently deleted. You'll stop receiving alerts immediately.

diag.title: Delivery status
diag.subtitle: Check that the server is watching your courses.
diag.failing_one: NTUST didn't respond on the last check
diag.failing_other: NTUST didn't respond on the last {{count}} checks

errors.internal: The server ran into a problem. Please try again shortly.
errors.rate_limited: You're going a bit fast — wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalid_token: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.email_unverified: A verified Google account is required.
errors.upstream_unavailable: The NTUST course system isn't responding. Try again in a minute.
errors.empty_query: Type a course number (2+ characters), name, or teacher.
errors.invalid_course_no: Course numbers only contain letters and digits.
errors.course_not_found: That course isn't offered in this semester.
errors.watchlist_full: Your watchlist is full. Remove a course to add another.

errors.discord_user_id_required: Add your Discord user ID so we can mention you.
errors.invalid_interval: Pick one of the listed intervals.
errors.invalid_body: Something about that request wasn't right. Refresh and try again.
errors.not_watched: That course isn't on your watchlist anymore.

errors.no_verified_email: No verified email on your account
errors.email_not_configured: Email isn't set up on this server
errors.discord_401: Discord rejected the webhook — copy a new URL
errors.discord_403: Discord rejected the webhook — copy a new URL
